newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, October 29 - Santa Fe - No vessels berthed/in roads/due. Max. draft 25 ft 11 in at access channel. Diamante - No vessels berthed/in roads/due. Max. draft 27 ft. 6 In at passage km 520. San Lorenzo - Five vessels berthed of which 1 loading sbmp, 1 loading sun pellets, 1 loading by-products, 1 loading sbm, 1 loading sbo. 7 In roads, 20 due at 9 terminals during the coming week. Pasa berth draft 22 ft. 1 in fw. Nidera berth draft 31 ft. 7 In. Fw. El Transito berth draft: 31 ft. 11 In. Fw. Rosario - Five vessels berthed of which 3 awaiting orders, 1 loading sugar, 1 loading sbo. 1 Vessel in roads, 7 due during the week. Max. Recommended draft 33 ft 3 in Forecast indicates it will keep rising for the next week.

Villa Constitucion - No vessels berthed/in roads. Elevators berth, 21 ft. 0 In. Fw. General cargo terminals, max. recommended draft 33 ft. 3 In. Forecast indicates that it will keep rising for the next week. San Nicolas - Three vessels berthed of which 1 discharging steel billets, 1 discharging iron ore. 1 loading steel products. 2 Vessels in roads, 8 due during the week. Max. Recommended draft 33 ft. 3 in. Forecast indicates that it will keep rising for the next week. San Pedro - No vessels berthed/in roads/due. Recommended draft guided by Emilio Mitre channel. Max. recommendable draft 33 ft. 3 in Fw. Guided by passage Isla Nueva between San Pedro and San Nicolas.

Buenos Aires - 23 Vessels in port, 20 due during the coming week. Max. Recommendable draft 31 ft. 6 In. Fw. High tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Buenos Aires dock, max Recommendable draft: 29 ft. Fw. High tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Necochea - Four vessels berthed of which 2 loading wheat, 1 loading sbmp, 1 discharging fertilisers. 2 vessels in roads, 9 due during the week. Max. Draft 40 ft. 0 In. Bahia Blanca - Five vessels berthed of which 2 loading sun oil, 1 discharging naphtha, 1 discharging crude, 1 discharging fish. 1 Vessel in roads, 10 due during the coming week. Draft depends on each berth.

BRAZIL, October 29 - Vitoria - Vessels berthed, 1 cellulose/paper coils loader, 1 pig iron loader, 1 granite loader, 1 steel products/granite loader, 1 containers/general cargo discharger/loader, 1 sugar loader, 1 malt discharger. Tubarao - 1 Iron ore loader. Praia Mole - 3 Steel plates loaders, 2 bulk coal dischargers. Portocel - 2 Cellulose loaders. Ubu - 1 Iron ore. Seventeen vessels waiting in roads. Santos - Vessels berthed, 9 full containers, 3 general cargo, 1 bulk cement discharger, 14 sugar loaders, 5 bulk fertiliser dischargers, 1 juice loader, 1 bulk sulphur discharger, 2 wheat dischargers, 1 cotton discharger, 2 pellets dischargers, 1 propane discharger, 2 diesel oil loaders. 36 Vessels waiting in roads, 85 due during next 7 days.

Private terminals - Cosipa - 1 Iron ore discharger, 1 steel products loader, 1 general cargo discharger. Ultrafertil - 1 Bulk fertiliser discharger. Rio Grande - Vessels berthed - 5 Bulk fertiliser dischargers, 2 full containers, 4 soya loaders, 1 wheat discharger. 3 Vessels waiting in roads, 26 due during next 10 days. Rio de Janeiro - Vessels berthed, 1 general cargo/steel products dischargers, 3 general cargo/steel products loaders, 2 wheat dischargers, 3 general cargo/container loaders, 1 sugar loader. Tecon - 1 Vessel. Twenty-three vessels due during next 7 days. Itajai - Vessels berthed, 1 general cargo, 1 reefer, 1 full container, bulker. 3 Vessels waiting in roads, 14 due during next 7 days. Sao Sebastiao - Tebar - 4 Vessels berthed, 2 waiting in roads, 9 due during next 7 days.

CHILE, October 28 - ARA - Three vessels operating, 1 berth vacant, no swell. 9 Vessels due during the week. Iquique - Three vessels operating, no berths vacant, 3 berths out of service due to maintenance until 2/11 (piers 4 and 5). No vessels waiting in roads, 11 due during the week. Antofagasta - Six vessels berthed, 1 berth available. 9 Vessels due during the week for loading and discharging concentrates, copper in bulk, containers and general cargo. No vessels in roads. Valparaiso - Five vessels operating at berth, 1 berth vacant, 1 berth out of service due to enlargement (pier 3 until april 1997). 16 Vessels due during the week. San Antonio - Seven vessels operating. 2 Vessels anchored in roads, 14 due during the week, No Waiting time.

Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - One vessel berthed, 5 due this week, none waiting in roads. San Vicente - Two vessels berthed, 1 berth vacant. No vessels waiting in roads, 4 due during the week. Steel pier - 1 Vessel in port, 1 berth available. Navy pier (molo 500) - No vessels. Lirquen - Two vessels operating, 4 berths vacant. No vessels in roads, 1 due. Penco - No vessels. Coronel pier - No vessels loading woodpulp. 1 Vessel due, 1 berth available. Oil terminal - 1 Vessel operating, None due during week. Puerto Montt - One vessel in port, no berths available. No vessels waiting in roads, 3 due during the week. Punta Arenas - Two vessels and 1 coaster berthed, 1 berth available. 4 Vessels and coasters due during the week. No vessels in roads.

PERU, October 28 - Callao - Seven vessels in bay, 10 in pier (general cargo/containers), no berthing delays. Paita - One fishmeal vessel in pier, no berthing delays. Bayovar - No vessels in port. Talara - One vessel in bay, in pier (oil), no berthing delays. Chimbote - One vessel in bay, 3 in pier (fishmeal), no berthing delays. Pisco - One vessel in pier (urea, salt), no berthing delays. Ilo - One copper vessel in pier, no berthing delays.

VENEZUELA, October 28 - Puerto Cabello - Three anchored. 12 Berthed of which 3 grain, 4 general cargo, 2 bulk cargo, 3 containers. Piers 1 and 2 closed. Guanta - Three anchored, 3 berthed. October 29 - Orinoco river draft 34 ft 6 in. Puerto Ordaz - One loading iron ore, 4 due. Boca Grande - One loading iron ore, 1 due. Mile 178 - Four waiting to load. Matanzas - Two waiting to load/discharge, 5 operating, 3 loading steel products, 1 discharging scrap, 1 discharging generals, 1 due. Venalum - Two loading aluminium. Punta Cuchillo - One loading. San Felix - Two due. Alcasa - One due. Puerto Cabello - Two waiting, 13 operating of which 10 loading/discharging generals, 1 malt, 2 grain, 17 due.

Guanta - Four operating, 1 discharging salt, 1 loading aluminum, 1 loading generals, 1 discharging wheat, 3 due. La Guaira - Seven loading/discharging generals, 3 due, 3 under repair. Maracaibo - Three loading/discharging generals. Bajo Grande - One loading crude, 1 due. Puerto Miranda - Three loading crude. El Tablazo - Two loading urea, 1 due. La Salina - Two loading crude. Buoy b71, Punta Palma, Punta Camacho, San Lorenzo, San Francisco, La Ceiba - No vessels. Cardon - Four waiting to load, 2 loading refined products. Guaranao - One loading/discharging generals. Amuay - Four waiting at anchorage to load, 5 loading products. Ports working normally.
